meta.siteTitle: Lux3D · Turn one photo into a 3D model with real materials
meta.siteDescription: Lux3D is an AI-native 3D generation and creation platform. Upload an image to get 3D assets with real PBR materials — then edit, rig, animate, batch-generate and plug them into your workflow.

print.headline: 3D AI built for printing
print.sub: Lux3D models are generated with printing in mind — watertight, manifold, ready to slice.

a.title: Born printable, not patched
a.desc: Watertight and manifold out of the box, and every export still runs a printability check that repairs holes and non-manifold edges. Click to watch it print layer by layer.

b.title: Multi-color, mapped to your filaments
b.desc: Color regions are cleaned into a few flat zones and mapped to the slots of an AMS or other multi-color system — crisp borders, no hand painting.

c.title: Auto Split for big or complex models
c.desc: Large or complex models are split into watertight parts with aligned joints, laid out on the plate, ready to print and assemble.

game.headline: Game assets that drop into your engine
game.sub: Characters that move, complete materials and face counts you control — from one image to something playable.

a.title: One-click PBR texturing
a.desc: A full PBR set — albedo, normal, metalness and roughness — with no shader setup. Turn on HD textures for crisp 4K detail in seconds.

b.title: Rig and animate your characters
b.desc: Auto-rigging for humanoids and quadrupeds, with presets for walking, running, jumping, idling and attacks. Click the ground to send it running.

c.title: Low poly for real-time performance
c.desc: Low Poly mode gives clean quad topology at a face count you choose, light enough to drop into your project. Drag the divider to compare.

game.hint: Click the ground to run there
game.name: Corgi

film.headline: One asset, every shot
film.sub: Fixed 3D assets keep characters and props identical from shot to shot — renders in seconds, with any camera and any light.

a.title: Render in seconds, move the camera freely
a.desc: Drop the asset into a shot and a progressive render resolves in seconds; drag to move the camera and it re-renders on release.

b.title: Relight without breaking
b.desc: Real PBR materials respond correctly to every light — neon, daylight or backlight — so relighting in post never falls apart.

c.title: Consistent characters across shots
c.desc: The hardest part of AI video is keeping a character the same from shot to shot. A fixed asset gives wide, medium and close-ups with no drift in shape or material.

film.hint: Click render, then drag to move the camera

q1.q: What kind of 3D models can Lux3D generate?
q1.a: Most objects — characters, animals, props, furniture, buildings and artifacts. Output is a mesh with full PBR materials, or 3D Gaussians.

q2.q: Do I need to know 3D modeling?
q2.a: No. Upload an image. Pros can keep going in the editor with remeshing, retexturing and rigging.

q3.a: GLB, FBX, OBJ, USDZ, STL and more — ready for Blender, Unity, Unreal and 3D printing.

q4.q: Can I use generated models commercially?
q4.a: Models generated on paid plans can be used commercially, subject to the Terms of Service.

q5.q: How do I use the API?
q5.a: Create an API key in the developer console and use the Python / TypeScript / Java SDK or REST endpoints. Your first job runs in minutes.
